title: SECOND TOMPKINS COUNTY COURTHOUSE, ITHACA, TOMPKINS COUNTY
author: Jerrye & Roy Klotz, MD
description: Building is brick but covered over with stucco; built in 1854. This building appears to be on the site of the first county courthouse which was wood. This building is at 121 E. Court Street but it does not match perfectly with Wikipedia's description of the building. However the pictures on Historic American Buildings website matches perfectly.

title: Tompkins County Family Court Ithaca New York
author: Kenneth C. Zirkel
description: Tompkins County Family Court, 320 N Tioga Street, Ithaca, New York. Built 1932, designed by J. Lakin Baldridge in Neo-Georgian style. This was the third courthouse in Tompkins County.
